title: Finite-strip graded map is mono
statement: Let C be an abelian category and K an integer commuting double cochain complex with total [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let r be natural and assume K.X i is zero for i<0 or r<=i. Let A be an integer cochain complex, b:A→Tot(K), and f_p:single(A.X p,0)→K.flip.X p for every integer p. Let F be a decreasing filtration of Cone(b) [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], whose degree-n step p is the join of the source image when p<=n+1 and the target diagonal images indexed by 0<=i<r and p<=n-i. The canonical map [def-sc-finite-strip-cone-graded-map] from Cone(f_p)^(n-p) to gr_F^p Cone(b)^n is monic for all integer p,n. No augmentation or differential identification hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Lemma 12.25.4 second-variable variant; explicit cone refinement of lem-sc-finite-strip-cone-filtration, step 3

proof.text: Construct the total projection using totalDesc, with the identity on component (n-p,p) and zero on every other component. Construct the source projection by the inverse single-object isomorphism when n+1=p and by zero otherwise. Combine them through the ambient and row cone biproduct isomorphisms. The composite with finiteStripRowInclusion is the identity, checked on the two biproduct inclusions; away from n+1=p the single source object is zero.

The next-tail subobject is contained in the kernel of the concrete row projection. Apply sup_le and Finset.sup_le to its stated generator formula. Its source generator can occur only when p+1<=n+1, so the source projection is zero. Its target generators have n-i>=p+1, so none is the selected component (n-p,p). Use imageSubobject_arrow_comp_eq_zero on each generator.

The evaluated next-step inclusion therefore composes to zero with the projection. Evaluation preserves cokernels, so CokernelCofork.IsColimit.desc' gives a descended arrow from the graded piece. Cancel the invertible image factor in the definition of finiteStripGradedMap and use Subobject.factorThru_arrow to identify its composite with the row-inclusion retraction identity. Cancel this left inverse to prove monomorphy.

proof_origin: K3 second reading: explicit diagonal projection, annihilation of next-tail generators, and evaluated cokernel descent; all steps proved in Lean without new holes or public helpers.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteStripGradedMap_mono
    (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    [K.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℤ)] (r : ℕ)
    (hsupport : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ (r : ℤ) ≤ i → IsZero (K.X i))
    (A : CochainComplex C ℤ) (b : A ⟶ K.total (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (f : ∀ p : ℤ,
      (HomologicalComplex.single C (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj (A.X p) ⟶ K.flip.X p)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone b))
    (hsteps : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
      (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
        ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl b).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
      (Finset.Ico (0 : ℤ) (r : ℤ)).sup (fun i ↦
        if p ≤ n - i then imageSubobject
          (K.ιTotalOrZero (ComplexShape.up ℤ) i (n - i) n ≫
            (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr b).f n) else ⊥))
    (p n : ℤ) : Mono (finiteStripGradedMap K r hsupport A b f F hsteps p n)
